children: Here's a list of key deals reported across sectors this week:

TNR Gold

agreed to be acquired by Altius Minerals (ATUSF), which will acquire all issued and outstanding common shares of the company it does not already own, and TNR Gold will spin out its interest in the Shotgun gold project in Alaska to a new company.
Greenfire Resources
surged 37.1% pre-market Monday after Stratchcona Resources (STHRF) agreed to
the Canadian oil sands producer in a deal worth as much as C$2.9B (US$2.1B) in cash and stock.

Mitsui Chemicals (MITSY) (MITSF) said Monday it agreed to acquire chip materials maker JSR jointly with the government-owned Development Bank of Japan from state-backed JIC Capital in a deal valued at ¥1.392T ($8.8B).
Samsung Electronics
is in talks to acquire Modine Manufacturing
, a U.S.-based manufacturer of data center cooling systems. MOD surged about 30% in Friday's early trading on the news.

Smart ring maker Oura (OURA) has acquired AI-native primary care company Counsel Health for $625M in cash, a transaction that will give Oura ring wearers greater access to proactive and personalized medical advice.
Siemens
said Tuesday it agreed to acquire German semiconductor software company Lauterbach, expanding its tools for designing and testing increasingly complex chips. Financial terms weren't disclosed.
